claims.assertion: Yazhi says the Sun appears white in space and atmospheric filtering makes its light look yellow from Earth.
claims.speaker: Yazhi Swaruu

claims.assertion: Athena says galactic energy waves span frequencies and can exceed light speed; effects depend on frequency compatibility between a wave and its recipient.
claims.speaker: Swaruu X (Athena)
claims.qualifiers: She describes astral and material perception as overlapping ranges.

claims.assertion: Yazhi says the Sun relays galactic gravity frequencies that can harmonize human DNA, but only individuals can choose lasting consciousness change.
claims.speaker: Yazhi Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: She links this process to a proposed 12-strand DNA pattern.
